scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @aml/api" "npm run dev --workspace @aml/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @aml/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @aml/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @aml/api && npm run build --workspace @aml/web
